title: Use the five gestures, or open the guide
lead: Hold a pose steadily. Peace sign opens the document scanner. Open the “How gestures work” guide anytime if you need a reminder.
buttonsOnlyNotice: Button navigation is on. Use Open scanner below, or try the camera again.

guide.title: Five gestures you can use
guide.lead: Hold a pose steadily in front of the camera. Ambiguous movement is ignored on purpose.

thumbs_up.name: Thumbs Up
thumbs_up.action: Trigger the current screen’s primary confirm/next action

thumbs_down.name: Thumbs Down
thumbs_down.action: Trigger the current screen’s back/cancel action

closed_fist.name: Closed Fist
closed_fist.action: Navigate to Emergency screen from anywhere
closed_fist.feedback: Closed fist recognized — opening emergency help
